title: Canonical ampleness of compact hyperbolic Kähler manifolds
summary: We prove that every compact connected Kähler manifold of positive complex dimension containing no nonconstant entire curve has ample canonical bundle and is projective. This resolves positively Kobayashi's canonical-ampleness conjecture in the smooth compact Kähler category.

review.reason: Proves canonical ampleness for compact hyperbolic Kähler manifolds, resolving Kobayashi's conjecture.
